_about: Side, valley and rear-gallery detail. Block coords (x passenger, y forward from the rear face, z up from the crank centreline). Wall points are given as (y, h): h is the distance up the side water-jacket wall from its lower edge, along the bore axis.

freeze_plugs.src: y [meas] album photo 431 rectified (brass cups, 3 per side, left bank 1" ahead of the right); d 1.75" [spec, BBC core plug]; height up the wall [est]

mount_holes.src: [est] three 3/8-16 motor-mount holes per side round the front freeze plug, on spot-faced pads (photo 431 shows tapped bosses there); for the ENS-3-1114G mounts

fuel_pump.src: [est] Gen VI fuel-pump boss on the passenger side at the front (block 19170540 has the boss); 2 x 3/8-16 and the pushrod opening

lifters.src: [spec] .8437" lifter bores, 16; axis through the cam centre, tilted 30 deg from vertical toward each bank so it opens into the valley floor [est]; intake/exhaust .70" either side of the cylinder centre [est]

distributor.src: [est] distributor bore at the rear of the valley, down to the cam's drive gear

rear_plugs_src: [est] lifter and main oil-gallery plugs at the rear face, on the same gallery lines as the front plugs (photo 29)
